rules.synthetic_rejection: Any dataset with synthetic: true is REJECTED for verdict runs (IS/OOS). Plumbing smoke tests are exempt but must be labeled.
rules.gate1_cfd_hard_rule: Gate 1 CFD validator checks manifest and rejects synthetic data before any backtest execution.
rules.gate1_crypto_hard_rule: Gate 1 CRYPTO validator checks manifest and rejects synthetic data; 24/7 continuity applies (missing 5m bar = gap, no weekend/holiday exemption).
